title: Reusable AWS ingress Terraform module with mTLS, internal NLB/ALB options, and pluggable health checks
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a single, reusable Terraform module to provision internal AWS ingress topology for Private (VPC) deployments. The module must support both ALB (HTTP/HTTPS) and NLB (TCP/TLS) patterns, optional mutual-TLS (mTLS) termination at the load balancer, TLS passthrough to targets, and a pluggable health-check configuration for different runtime targets (EC2, ECS, and self-hosted on k8s nodes). It should be opinionated enough to provide secure defaults (internal-only subnets, least-privilege IAM, cert rotation hooks) while allowing advanced operators to override settings. The goal is to reduce duplication across customer Private deployments, simplify upgrades, and make health checks observable in Console metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes a single set of inputs for selecting mode: alb_http, alb_https, nlb_tls, nlb_tcp
Supporting mTLS toggle when using ALB with documented limitations
TLS certificate can be supplied as ARN or automated via ACM + DNS validation helpers
Health check config is templated and can be replaced with a user-provided JSON/structure (timeout, path, healthy_threshold, unhealthy_threshold)
Output includes load balancer DNS, target group ARNs, security group IDs, and metric ARNs for CloudWatch
Module has automated test coverage in terratest (basic plan/apply/destroy in a sandbox account)
task_list: Draft design doc and API surface for module inputs/outputs
Prototype ALB with HTTPS + mTLS using ACM certs in sandbox account
Prototype NLB with TLS passthrough and target group health checks
Implement Terraform module with submodule for certificates and DNS helpers
Add IAM policy module for least-privilege cert and ELB actions
Write terratest tests + CI job to run quarterly
Document upgrade notes and rollback strategy in Confluence
Add Console instrumentation hooks (tagging resources, CW metrics mapping)
comments: 2025-03-02: Kickoff sync with PM and Security. Agreed on internal-only default; public-facing will be a separate feature. Security requested mTLS be opt-in and reviewed separately.

2025-03-05: PoC ALB mTLS successful in sandbox. Noted ALB client authentication requires TLS listener + target group with HTTPS. Logged performance trade-off: mTLS increases CPU on LB and may affect latency for high-throughput customers.

2025-03-07: Design decision: Support two TLS termination modes: terminate-at-loadbalancer and passthrough-to-target. Passthrough implemented via NLB TCP/TLS listeners to preserve upstream certs for on-prem targets.

2025-03-10: Engineering review (PR feedback): prefer using module composition (certs module, lb module, target-group module) to avoid duplication. Suggestion to expose a 'health_check_template' variable that accepts a rendered JSON string.
2025-03-12: Added metrics instrumentation plan: tag TGs with team/customer and expose CW metric filters in Console. TODO: coordinate with Console team for dashboard mapping.
2025-03-14: Security review in progress. Security asked for KMS-backed SSM parameter for ACM validation tokens and verification of IAM role boundaries. Marked security_review_required=true.

2025-03-16: WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/342 - includes initial module scaffolding and examples. Requesting reviewers: @infra-team, @security. Related design doc: https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/INF/Private+Ingress+Module+Design

2025-03-18: Terratest harness drafted at https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/tree/main/test/ingress-module-tests. Initial plan/apply/destroy passed for alb_http and nlb_tcp scenarios in sandbox account. Need to add mTLS automated test and expand to ECS targets. Assigned follow-up tasks for reliability: add health-check grace period and circuit-breaker notes.
